Welcome to *Data Analysis & Visualisation with R*, an 8 hour workshop designed to introduce the R programming language to researchers who have no programming experience.

# Getting Set Up

Follow the instructions on the [set up](setup.html) page before the workshop.

# Learning Objectives

The primary objective of this workshop is to introduce attendees to the R programming language. By the end of the workshop you will be able to:

- Build and modify plots to visualise tabular data.
- Explore tabular datasets using vectors, data frames, and functions.
- Import, manipulate, and export datasets and figures.
